QuestInfo.name: A Third Gift for the Dragon Master
QuestInfo.0: When you reach Lv. 60, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
QuestInfo.1: #p9010010# congratulates you for reaching Lv. 60 and asks that you come see her so that she can give you another scroll. Just how many scrolls has #p9010010# prepared? In any case, go to town and meet #p9010010#.
QuestInfo.2: You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says that she will give you an even better scroll if you reach Lv. 80 by #bMay 5#k.

0.0: Wow, Evan! You're Lv. 60 already? You really are fast... This is all so that you can get my gifts right? Hehehe, I guess everyone need a little motivation. Come #bfind me in town#k so that I can give you the scroll.

no.0: Hmm. Why are you acting like you weren't expecting the scroll? Now, now, I can see through that. I know exactly what you're thinking, so no need to pretend to refuse.

1.0: I'm glad you're here Evan. Let's just cut to the chase. Here is the scroll that you so desired!

yes.0: You probably expected this...but this is not #bthe end#k of the scrolls! I will give you the next scroll if you can reach #bLevel 80 by May 4th#k. The next scroll will be better than the previous ones! See you next time, Evan.
